dotnet.source_global_json_policy: Do not edit tracked global.json. The existing 10.0.100/latestFeature policy selects 10.0.403 from the isolated installation. Verify the actual selected SDK in every exact-revision worktree.

local_validation.checks: YAML/JSON/Python/PowerShell statics; exact binary overlay/deps, one-test/sample counts and timeout fixtures; two bounded pair/orders only; no local product execution.
local_validation.known_linter_catalog_mismatch: Unfiltered actionlint 1.7.12 rejects only ubuntu-26.04, which the current official GitHub standard/free runner reference lists without a preview marker. The narrow ignore handles this catalog drift; no workflow-expression or other lint diagnostic is ignored.
local_validation.product_executions: Not run locally: no product build/test, supplementary timing, native publish/run or profiling.
local_validation.ci_execution: Not run: preparation does not publish a branch, create a PR, dispatch Actions or alter credentials/repository policy.
local_validation.local_shell_route: WindowsPowerShell5.1 plus existing Python3.15.2: MXC rejected packaged PowerShell7 before execution. No global tools or policies changed. Both workflow PowerShell blocks parsed with the native5.1 parser; CI uses existing hosted pwsh.

fixture_results.semantic_metadata_equality_gate: passed, including nonzero selection and mismatched/incomplete rejection

static_results.actionlint: passed with sole documented ubuntu26.04 catalog exception

source.source_resolution: Input, sole direct parent of exact two-file CI-only commit and recorded final source must match. Separate A/C worktrees use baseline/final; only unchanged untracked harness is injected.

components.A: Baseline complete runtime tree and baseline unit DLL/PDB
components.C: Final complete runtime tree and final unit DLL/PDB; build origin only, not timed
components.H: Copy A; replace only unit DLL/PDB from C
components.P: Copy C; replace only unit DLL/PDB from A
components.proof: Hash every regular file recursively; A/C runtime copies match build origins. H against A, P against C, only exact DLL/PDB donor copies allowed. Unrelated A/C files may differ. Reinventory after timing. Reject unsupported symlinks.

measurement.protocol_identity: Unchanged frozen C# harness, custom supplementary binary-factor orchestration. Original run-comparison.py is not invoked or claimed to run.
measurement.cwd_policy: Own sibling prebuilt runtime-bin container at uniform path depth, explicitly recorded; supplementary copy context, not original primary source-worktree cwd.
measurement.exclusivity: Both builds, copies, inventories, assembly inspection and SDK queries finish before four timing batches. During them launch only exact direct processes: no unrelated external command/build/test/profiler or between-batch query. Validate all raw records afterward.
measurement.exact_test_gate: CLIexit0 and one xUnit Total1/Errors0/Failed0/Skipped0/NotRun0 summary; raw output independently requires four records per side, one per process, all24 time/allocation samples. Ignore culture-specific Time text.
measurement.raw_policy: Fresh directory for each comparison/order; retain original A/B labels with B=H/P mapping, all failures/vectors/logs. No deletion, numerical threshold, retry or original-primary acceptance. Timeout aborts later product phases.
measurement.semantic_metadata_gate: Require nonnegative integer selected/selectedCells and identical count/selected/selectedCells/virtualSurface across all8 A/B processes of each comparison/scenario. Do not assume zero selection or infer actual realization equality.

interpretation.A_vs_H: Host DLL/PDB replacement effect with non-host baseline bytes fixed.
interpretation.A_vs_P: Final non-host runtime-set effect with baseline host DLL/PDB fixed; multiple source-built binaries may differ.
interpretation.limits: C is not timed contemporaneously. No additive decomposition of A/C, exclusion of interactions, proven root cause or automatic primary acceptance. Equal reported metadata does not prove identical actual realization or equal hot-path work.
interpretation.acceptance: Supplementary causal-diagnosis evidence only; no numerical allowance, threshold, cherry-picking or replacement of primary evidence.
interpretation.parent_supplied_motivation: Windows source-to-array H+1373/+691B vs P-86/+10B; scroll H+757/+13796B vs P-75/+2734B. Repeated Linux primary scroll positives near+9KB/+4KB with near-zero A/A remain unresolved. These motivate control, are not rerun here and do not prove causality.

reused_evidence.full_source_scope: Original failure retained, including Mac6018pass+1fail; primary/semantic successes stay separately scoped.
reused_evidence.functional_recheck_status_at_preparation: success: baseline1pass/final1pass/unfilteredfinal6019pass; initial failure retained; no external race-fix claim
reused_evidence.native_scope: Earlier successful exact-source native-only actual executions on all three OS, not repeated.
reused_evidence.reuse_policy: All listed phases explicitly Not run with links, never relabeled passed. Keep original failures and primary positive estimates.

timeouts.policy: Raw output live under staging; attempt process-tree/group termination then abort later product phases after timeout even if cleanup uncertain. Step leaves always-upload time.

retention.upload: Immediate root and timing-batch logs/JSON/JSONL only; no recursive runtime/source/build/Git/CodeGraph upload.
retention.live_results: Process logs and original append-only raw JSONL already uploadable on timeout; no post-run copy.
retention.inputs: Preserve A/C worktrees/build origins and all A/C/H/P runtime bins until VM decommissioning; no cleanup/recycling.

assembly_metadata.method: Before timing inspect actual top-level DLL AssemblyName identities and file/product versions with existing PowerShell, recording inspector versions separately. SHA256 proves byte identity; version strings do not.
assembly_metadata.coverage: Official general API docs, not SDK-versioned coverage; actual SDK10.0.403/runtime10.0.14 verified per worktree.

manual_dispatch_note: workflow_dispatch requires default-branch file. Host-controls push body replaces the same two CI paths directly on d0; no full/native workflow alongside it.
